descriptions.zh: 恒星辐射的快速变化威胁着母星的稳定。若继续如此，§Y[Owner.Capital.GetStarName]§!终将发生新星爆发，粉碎整个恒星系。
descriptions.en: The rapid changes in our star's emissions threaten the stability of our homeworld. If this continues, §Y[Owner.Capital.GetStarName]§! will eventually go nova, atomizing the system.

descriptions.zh: 挖掘揭露了地下设施，其中藏有先进科技、档案数据和更多沉睡亲族的休眠舱。我们的历史就埋藏于此；若能挖掘全部，或许最终能明白自己是谁。
descriptions.en: Our excavation has revealed subterranean facilities housing advanced technology, archived data, and stasis pods containing more of our dormant kin. Our history itself is buried here; if we can dig it all up, we may finally understand who we are.

descriptions.zh:
我们对§Y结晶熵§!的掌控即将开启星系激变。已开通连接星系核心6个恒星系的虫洞。
若在各恒星系建立§Y导管群§!设施，并守护免受干涉，我们即可燃烧整个星系。
descriptions.en:
Our mastery of §YCrystallized Entropy§! will soon allow us to begin a radical transformation of the galaxy. We have opened wormholes to six systems around the galactic core.
If we establish §YConduits§! in each of these, and defend them from anyone who would meddle with our plans, we will be able to set the galaxy itself ablaze.

descriptions.zh:
§L我们憧憬着火焰乌托邦，为达成愿景必须清除一切阻碍。第一束火光已升起，必须助长其燃烧，让烈焰蔓延至星系的每一个角落。§!

descriptions.en:
§LWe envision a blazing utopia, but to create it we must incinerate everything that stands in our way. We've lit the first sparks, and must now stoke the flames until every corner of the galaxy has been consumed.§!
